source_id: PMS-AFR-010: track application status and progress
purpose: Verify an Applicant can view the current status and progress of their own submitted patent applications.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant owns at least one patent application in PMS.
action_or_input: Applicant requests status and progress view for their patent application.
expected_result: PMS displays the status and progress information for the Applicant's application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-016: view reports for own applications
purpose: Verify an Applicant can view reports concerning their own patent applications.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant has patent application records in PMS.
action_or_input: Applicant requests personal application reports for their applications.
expected_result: PMS provides report data for applications belonging to that Applicant.

source_id: PMS-AFR-023: Director domain workflow oversight
purpose: Verify a Director receives oversight information for application workflows in their domain.
preconditions: An authenticated Director has applications in their domain/oversight scope.
action_or_input: Director accesses workflow oversight information within their domain.
expected_result: PMS displays workflow oversight information for applications in the Director's domain.

source_id: PMS-AFR-026: PCC_ADMIN monitor workflows and resolve conflict-of-interest cases
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can monitor workflows and resolve a conflict-of-interest case within PMS.
preconditions: An authenticated PCC_ADMIN is active in PMS and a conflict-of-interest case exists in a PMS workflow.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN monitors active workflows and records resolution for the conflict-of-interest case.
expected_result: PMS reflects workflow monitoring data and records the conflict-of-interest resolution within PMS scope.

source_id: PMS-AFR-027: PCC_ADMIN manage configuration and role assignments
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can update PMS configuration and user-role assignments.
preconditions: An authenticated PCC_ADMIN is active in PMS and a target user account exists.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN submits a PMS configuration update and assigns a PMS role to the target user.
expected_result: PMS saves the updated configuration and applies the user-role assignment.

source_id: PMS-AFR-029: PCC_ADMIN handle escalations and exceptional cases
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can handle PMS escalations and exceptional cases.
preconditions: An authenticated PCC_ADMIN is active and an escalated or exceptional PMS item exists.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN processes and records action on the escalation or exceptional case.
expected_result: PMS updates the escalated/exceptional case according to PCC_ADMIN's handling action.

source_id: PMS-AFR-030: PCC_ADMIN maintain attorney panels and expertise mappings
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can add or update attorney panel membership and domain expertise mappings.
preconditions: An authenticated PCC_ADMIN is active and an Attorney record exists.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN adds/updates the Attorney on an approved panel and assigns expertise domain mappings.
expected_result: PMS persists the updated attorney panel status and expertise mappings.

source_id: PMS-AFR-037: Attorney legal advice records
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record legal advice throughout the patent lifecycle.
preconditions: An authenticated Attorney is assigned to or handling a patent application within authorized scope.
action_or_input: Attorney submits a legal advice record on the patent application.
expected_result: PMS stores the legal advice record associated with the patent application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-038: submit patent application with required sections
purpose: Verify an Applicant can submit a patent application containing title, abstract, detailed description, claims, inventor information, and supporting documents.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant prepares a complete application with title, abstract, detailed description, claims, inventor information, and valid supporting PDF documents.
action_or_input: Applicant submits the completed patent application.
expected_result: PMS accepts the application submission with all provided required sections and supporting documents.

source_id: PMS-AFR-039: require patent application documents to be PDF files
purpose: Verify PMS accepts PDF files for patent application documents.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant is submitting a patent application document.
action_or_input: Applicant attaches a PDF document file.
expected_result: PMS accepts the document file format as a PDF file.

source_id: PMS-AFR-039: reject non-PDF patent application documents
purpose: Verify PMS rejects non-PDF application documents.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant is submitting a patent application with a non-PDF file.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to attach or submit the non-PDF file.
expected_result: PMS rejects the non-PDF document.

source_id: PMS-AFR-040: reject documents larger than 50 MB
purpose: Verify PMS rejects a patent application document exceeding 50 MB.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant has a PDF document larger than 50 MB.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to upload or submit the document larger than 50 MB.
expected_result: PMS rejects the document because its size exceeds 50 MB.

source_id: PMS-AFR-041: validate documents as malware-free before accepting
purpose: Verify PMS checks submitted application documents for malware before accepting them and rejects infected files.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant submits a document flagged as containing malware.
action_or_input: Applicant submits the malware-flagged document.
expected_result: PMS does not accept the malware-flagged document.

source_id: PMS-AFR-042: validate completeness of submission information
purpose: Verify PMS rejects an application submission when required submission information is incomplete.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant prepares a patent application missing required submission information.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to submit the incomplete application.
expected_result: PMS rejects the submission due to incomplete application information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-043: classify submitted documents by sensitivity
purpose: Verify PMS classifies submitted documents by sensitivity.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant submits application documents.
action_or_input: Applicant submits the application documents.
expected_result: PMS records a sensitivity classification on the submitted documents.

source_id: PMS-AFR-044: assign unique application ID
purpose: Verify PMS assigns a unique application ID to each accepted patent application.
preconditions: Two valid patent applications are submitted by Applicants.
action_or_input: Submit both patent applications.
expected_result: Each accepted application receives a distinct, unique application ID.

source_id: PMS-AFR-045: set status to Submitted upon submission
purpose: Verify PMS sets application status to Submitted after successful submission.
preconditions: An authenticated Applicant submits a valid, complete patent application.
action_or_input: Complete application submission.
expected_result: The application's status is set to Submitted.

source_id: PMS-AFR-046: require inventor agreements before filing
purpose: Verify PMS enforces completion of inventor agreements before filing.
preconditions: A patent application has incomplete inventor agreements.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed to filing while inventor agreements are incomplete.
expected_result: PMS prevents progression to filing until inventor agreements are completed.

source_id: PMS-AFR-047: record application history
purpose: Verify PMS records application history for each patent application.
preconditions: A patent application is submitted and undergoes a recorded workflow event.
action_or_input: Submit the application and perform a recorded history event.
expected_result: PMS appends the events to the application's history record.

source_id: PMS-AFR-048: notify stakeholders after submission or status update
purpose: Verify PMS notifies relevant stakeholders after application submission or a history-relevant status update.
preconditions: Relevant stakeholders are associated with the application.
action_or_input: Submit a patent application or trigger a history-relevant status update.
expected_result: PMS triggers notifications to the relevant stakeholders.

source_id: PMS-AFR-049: PCC_ADMIN assigns submitted applications to Directors
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can assign a submitted application to an eligible Director.
preconditions: An application has status Submitted and an eligible Director exists.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN assigns the application to the Director.
expected_result: PMS records the Director assignment on the application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-050: automatic assignment to Directors when rules are available
purpose: Verify PMS can automatically assign submitted applications to Directors when configured assignment rules are available.
preconditions: Configured automatic assignment rules and eligible Directors are available, and a valid application is submitted.
action_or_input: Submit a patent application with automatic assignment rules active.
expected_result: PMS automatically assigns the application to a Director according to the configured rules.

source_id: PMS-AFR-051: Director expertise matching criterion
purpose: Verify Director assignment matches Director expertise with the application domain.
preconditions: Applications exist in distinct technical domains and Directors have mapped expertise domains.
action_or_input: Assign or route an application to a Director.
expected_result: PMS selects a Director whose expertise matches the application domain.

source_id: PMS-AFR-052: Director workload balance criterion
purpose: Verify Director assignment considers Director workload balance.
preconditions: Multiple eligible Directors match domain expertise with different current review workloads.
action_or_input: Assign or route an application across the eligible Directors.
expected_result: PMS applies workload balance when selecting the assigned Director.

source_id: PMS-AFR-053: conflict-of-interest checks before Director assignment
purpose: Verify PMS performs conflict-of-interest checks before assigning an application to a Director.
preconditions: A conflict of interest exists between a Director and a patent application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or route the conflicted application to that Director.
expected_result: PMS flags or blocks assignment to the conflicted Director based on the conflict-of-interest check.

source_id: PMS-AFR-054: prevent Director from reviewing own inventor application
purpose: Verify PMS prevents a Director from reviewing an application where they are listed as an inventor.
preconditions: A Director is listed as an inventor on a patent application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or have that Director review the application.
expected_result: PMS prevents the inventor-Director from being assigned/reviewing the application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-055: prevent PCC_ADMIN from reviewing own inventor application
purpose: Verify PMS prevents PCC_ADMIN from reviewing an application where they are listed as an inventor.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is listed as an inventor on a patent application.
action_or_input: Attempt to have PCC_ADMIN review the application.
expected_result: PMS prevents PCC_ADMIN from reviewing an application where they are an inventor.

source_id: PMS-AFR-056: update status to Under Review upon assignment
purpose: Verify PMS updates application status to Under Review upon Director assignment.
preconditions: A submitted patent application is assigned to a Director.
action_or_input: Complete Director assignment for the application.
expected_result: The application status changes to Under Review.

source_id: PMS-AFR-057: notify assigned Director and initiate review timeline
purpose: Verify PMS notifies the assigned Director and initiates the review timeline upon assignment.
preconditions: An application is assigned to a Director.
action_or_input: Assign the application to the Director.
expected_result: PMS sends a notification to the assigned Director and starts the review timeline.

source_id: PMS-AFR-058: Director views assigned application details and documents
purpose: Verify an assigned Director can view application details, documents, and supporting materials.
preconditions: An application with documents and supporting materials is assigned to a Director.
action_or_input: Director opens the assigned application's details, documents, and supporting materials.
expected_result: PMS displays the application details, documents, and supporting materials to the assigned Director.

source_id: PMS-AFR-059: Director chooses Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision
purpose: Verify a Director can record a review decision of Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision.
preconditions: An application is assigned to a Director for review with valid justification of at least 50 characters.
action_or_input: Director submits a review decision choosing Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision.
expected_result: PMS records the chosen review decision on the application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-060: reject decision with fewer than 50 characters of justification
purpose: Verify PMS rejects a Director decision when justification has fewer than 50 characters.
preconditions: An assigned Director is recording a review decision.
action_or_input: Director submits a decision with a justification shorter than 50 characters.
expected_result: PMS rejects the decision because justification must be at least 50 characters.

source_id: PMS-AFR-060: accept decision with at least 50 characters of justification
purpose: Verify PMS accepts a Director decision when justification has at least 50 characters.
preconditions: An assigned Director is recording a review decision.
action_or_input: Director submits a decision with a justification of at least 50 characters.
expected_result: PMS accepts the justification length requirement for the decision.

source_id: PMS-AFR-061: enforce 15-business-day Director review completion
purpose: Verify PMS enforces the 15-business-day review timeline from assignment for Director review.
preconditions: An application is assigned to a Director and the 15-business-day review window is tracked.
action_or_input: Advance simulated time past 15 business days from assignment without a completed review.
expected_result: PMS reflects that the 15-business-day review timeline condition has elapsed.

source_id: PMS-AFR-062: notify Applicant with detailed feedback on rejection
purpose: Verify PMS notifies the Applicant with detailed feedback when an application is rejected.
preconditions: An assigned Director rejects an application with detailed justification/feedback.
action_or_input: Director submits the Reject decision.
expected_result: PMS sends a notification to the Applicant containing the detailed rejection feedback.

source_id: PMS-AFR-063: notify Applicant with detailed feedback on revision request
purpose: Verify PMS notifies the Applicant with detailed feedback when Needs Revision is chosen.
preconditions: An assigned Director selects Needs Revision with detailed justification/feedback.
action_or_input: Director submits the Needs Revision decision.
expected_result: PMS sends a notification to the Applicant containing the detailed revision feedback.

source_id: PMS-AFR-064: route approved applications to attorney assignment
purpose: Verify PMS routes approved applications to the attorney assignment stage.
preconditions: An assigned Director approves an application.
action_or_input: Director submits the Approve decision.
expected_result: PMS routes the approved application to the attorney assignment workflow step.

source_id: PMS-AFR-065: audit trail of Director review process
purpose: Verify PMS maintains an audit trail of the Director review process.
preconditions: An assigned Director reviews and records a decision on an application.
action_or_input: Director completes a review decision.
expected_result: PMS records audit trail entries for the review actions and decision.

source_id: PMS-AFR-066: revise applications with status Needs Revision
purpose: Verify an Applicant can revise an application whose status is Needs Revision.
preconditions: A patent application has status Needs Revision.
action_or_input: Applicant revises the application to address feedback and resubmits within 60 days.
expected_result: PMS allows revision and processes the resubmission for an application with status Needs Revision.

source_id: PMS-AFR-067: revise applications with status Rejected
purpose: Verify an Applicant can revise an application whose status is Rejected.
preconditions: A patent application has status Rejected.
action_or_input: Applicant revises the application and resubmits within 60 days of the rejection decision date.
expected_result: PMS allows revision and processes the resubmission for an application with status Rejected.

source_id: PMS-AFR-068: 60-day resubmission period
purpose: Verify PMS enforces the 60-day resubmission window from the rejection or revision-request decision date.
preconditions: An application received a Rejected or Needs Revision decision more than 60 days ago.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to resubmit after the 60-day resubmission period has passed.
expected_result: PMS rejects late resubmission outside the 60-day resubmission period.

source_id: PMS-AFR-069: validate revision addresses Director feedback
purpose: Verify PMS validates that a revision submission addresses Director feedback.
preconditions: An application requires revision based on Director feedback.
action_or_input: Applicant submits a revision that does not address the Director feedback.
expected_result: PMS validation rejects or flags the revision for failing to address Director feedback.

source_id: PMS-AFR-070: start new review cycle after resubmission
purpose: Verify PMS starts a new review cycle after a valid revised application is resubmitted.
preconditions: An eligible revised application is validly resubmitted within the allowed period.
action_or_input: Submit the revised application.
expected_result: PMS initiates a new review cycle for the resubmitted application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-071: version control for revised applications
purpose: Verify PMS maintains version control for revised applications.
preconditions: An application is revised and resubmitted.
action_or_input: Submit a revised version of the application.
expected_result: PMS retains version history distinguishing the revised version from prior versions.

source_id: PMS-AFR-072: expire application when resubmission deadline expires
purpose: Verify PMS changes application status to Expired when the revision resubmission deadline expires.
preconditions: An application is awaiting revision/resubmission and its resubmission deadline expires.
action_or_input: Advance time past the resubmission deadline without resubmission.
expected_result: PMS updates the application status to Expired.

source_id: PMS-AFR-074: only PCC_ADMIN may assign attorneys to approved applications
purpose: Verify only PCC_ADMIN can assign attorneys to approved applications and non-PCC_ADMIN users are denied.
preconditions: An application is Approved; a non-PCC_ADMIN user attempts attorney assignment.
action_or_input: Non-PCC_ADMIN user attempts to assign an attorney to the approved application.
expected_result: PMS denies the attorney assignment attempt.

source_id: PMS-AFR-075: require attorneys from approved panel unless exception granted
purpose: Verify PMS requires attorneys to be selected from the approved panel unless an exception is granted.
preconditions: An Attorney is not on the approved panel and no exception has been granted.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN attempts to assign the non-panel Attorney without an exception.
expected_result: PMS rejects assigning an Attorney outside the approved panel when no exception is granted.

source_id: PMS-AFR-076: consider attorney expertise matching domain
purpose: Verify attorney assignment considers attorney expertise matching the application domain.
preconditions: Attorneys have domain expertise mappings and an approved application has a technical domain.
action_or_input: Perform attorney assignment for the application.
expected_result: PMS evaluates/matches attorney expertise against the application domain.

source_id: PMS-AFR-077: consider attorney current workload
purpose: Verify attorney assignment considers each attorney's current workload.
preconditions: Eligible attorneys have different current assignment workloads.
action_or_input: Perform attorney assignment.
expected_result: PMS factors attorney workload into the assignment selection.

source_id: PMS-AFR-078: conflict-of-interest checks before attorney assignment
purpose: Verify PMS performs conflict-of-interest checks before attorney assignment.
preconditions: A conflict of interest exists between an Attorney and the application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign the application to the conflicted Attorney.
expected_result: PMS detects/prevents assignment to the conflicted Attorney.

source_id: PMS-AFR-079: consider Applicant preference when preferred attorney is in approved panel
purpose: Verify PMS considers Applicant attorney preference when the preferred attorney is in the approved panel.
preconditions: An Applicant specifies a preferred attorney who is on the approved panel.
action_or_input: Assign an attorney for the application.
expected_result: PMS considers the Applicant's preference for the approved-panel attorney.

source_id: PMS-AFR-079: do not apply Applicant preference when preferred attorney is outside approved panel
purpose: Verify PMS does not honor Applicant attorney preference when the preferred attorney is not in the approved panel.
preconditions: An Applicant specifies a preferred attorney who is not on the approved panel.
action_or_input: Assign an attorney for the application.
expected_result: PMS does not apply the Applicant's preference for the attorney outside the approved panel.

source_id: PMS-AFR-080: assigned Attorney accepts or declines assignment
purpose: Verify an assigned Attorney can accept or decline an assignment.
preconditions: An application assignment is offered to an Attorney.
action_or_input: Attorney records either acceptance or decline of the assignment.
expected_result: PMS records the Attorney's acceptance or decline decision.

source_id: PMS-AFR-081: record assignment outcome as Attorney Assigned or Pending Review
purpose: Verify PMS records the attorney-assignment outcome using Attorney Assigned or Pending Review as applicable.
preconditions: An attorney assignment action/response occurs on an application.
action_or_input: Complete attorney assignment / acceptance outcome.
expected_result: PMS sets/records the applicable status (Attorney Assigned or Pending Review).

source_id: PMS-AFR-082: Attorney records legal and patentability analysis
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record legal and patentability analysis for an assigned application.
preconditions: An Attorney is assigned to an application.
action_or_input: Attorney submits legal and patentability analysis content.
expected_result: PMS saves the legal and patentability analysis for the application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-083: Attorney records prior-art searches in relevant databases
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record prior-art searches performed in relevant databases.
preconditions: An Attorney is conducting patentability review on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Attorney records prior-art search details from relevant databases.
expected_result: PMS stores the recorded prior-art search information on the assessment.

source_id: PMS-AFR-084: Attorney records novelty, non-obviousness, and utility evaluations
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record evaluations of novelty, non-obviousness, and utility.
preconditions: An Attorney is performing patentability assessment on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Attorney submits evaluations for novelty, non-obviousness, and utility.
expected_result: PMS records the novelty, non-obviousness, and utility evaluations.

source_id: PMS-AFR-085: patentability opinion recommendation constraint
purpose: Verify an Attorney's patentability opinion includes one of File Patent, Do Not File, or Needs Amendment.
preconditions: An Attorney is recording a patentability opinion.
action_or_input: Attorney submits a patentability opinion selecting File Patent, Do Not File, or Needs Amendment.
expected_result: PMS accepts and records the opinion with the selected valid recommendation.

source_id: PMS-AFR-086: Attorney requests additional information during legal review
purpose: Verify an Attorney can request additional information during legal review.
preconditions: An Attorney is conducting legal review of an application.
action_or_input: Attorney submits a request for additional information.
expected_result: PMS records the request for additional information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-087: Attorney requests extensions during legal review
purpose: Verify an Attorney can request an extension during legal review.
preconditions: An Attorney is conducting legal review of an application.
action_or_input: Attorney submits a legal review extension request.
expected_result: PMS records the extension request for legal review.

source_id: PMS-AFR-088: record Attorney patentability opinion
purpose: Verify PMS records a completed Attorney patentability opinion.
preconditions: An Attorney completes a patentability opinion on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Submit the patentability opinion.
expected_result: PMS persists the recorded patentability opinion on the application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-089: notify stakeholders after Attorney opinion recorded
purpose: Verify PMS notifies relevant stakeholders after an Attorney patentability opinion is recorded.
preconditions: Stakeholders are associated with the application.
action_or_input: Record an Attorney patentability opinion.
expected_result: PMS triggers notifications to relevant stakeholders.

source_id: PMS-AFR-090: Director reviews patent filing and prosecution costs
purpose: Verify a Director can review costs for patent filing and prosecution.
preconditions: A patent application has filing and prosecution budget cost information.
action_or_input: Director opens the budget/cost details for review.
expected_result: PMS displays the filing and prosecution cost details to the Director.

source_id: PMS-AFR-091: Director approves filing and prosecution costs
purpose: Verify a Director can approve costs for an eligible application within threshold and budget availability.
preconditions: An application has status Approved, budget costs are within threshold, and budget availability is satisfied.
action_or_input: Director approves the filing and prosecution costs.
expected_result: PMS records the Director's budget approval.

source_id: PMS-AFR-092: include filing fees in budget information
purpose: Verify budget information includes filing fees.
preconditions: A patent budget record is created or viewed.
action_or_input: Provide or inspect budget cost components.
expected_result: Filing fees are represented in the budget information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-093: include attorney fees in budget information
purpose: Verify budget information includes attorney fees.
preconditions: A patent budget record is created or viewed.
action_or_input: Provide or inspect budget cost components.
expected_result: Attorney fees are represented in the budget information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-094: include administrative costs in budget information
purpose: Verify budget information includes administrative costs.
preconditions: A patent budget record is created or viewed.
action_or_input: Provide or inspect budget cost components.
expected_result: Administrative costs are represented in the budget information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-095: escalate when total cost exceeds configured threshold limit
purpose: Verify PMS escalates to higher authority when total budget cost exceeds the configured threshold limit.
preconditions: A configured cost threshold limit exists and a budget's total cost exceeds that threshold.
action_or_input: Submit or route the budget whose total cost exceeds the configured threshold limit.
expected_result: PMS routes/escalates the budget case to higher authority.

source_id: PMS-AFR-096: allow budget approval only for status Approved
purpose: Verify PMS blocks budget approval when application status is not Approved.
preconditions: A patent application is in a status other than Approved.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve budget costs for the non-Approved application.
expected_result: PMS rejects budget approval because the application status is not Approved.

source_id: PMS-AFR-097: validate budget availability before approval
purpose: Verify PMS validates budget availability before approval when budget-availability information is available.
preconditions: Budget-availability data is available and indicates insufficient budget for approval.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the budget when budget availability is insufficient.
expected_result: PMS prevents budget approval due to insufficient budget availability.

source_id: PMS-AFR-098: log financial transactions with authorization-level information
purpose: Verify PMS logs financial transactions along with authorization-level information.
preconditions: A budget/financial action is recorded with authorization metadata.
action_or_input: Record the financial budget action.
expected_result: PMS logs the financial transaction including authorization-level information.

source_id: PMS-AFR-099: Attorney prepares application package for filing
purpose: Verify an Attorney can prepare an application package for patent-office filing.
preconditions: An Attorney is assigned to an eligible application.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares and saves the filing application package.
expected_result: PMS records the prepared application package for filing.

source_id: PMS-AFR-100: validate filing-package format compliance
purpose: Verify PMS validates filing-package format compliance against available patent-office standard rules.
preconditions: Patent-office format validation rules are available and a non-compliant package is submitted.
action_or_input: Submit a filing package that violates the available format compliance rules.
expected_result: PMS rejects or flags the filing package for format non-compliance.

source_id: PMS-AFR-101: record submission to Indian Patent Office
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record submission of an application to the Indian Patent Office.
preconditions: An Attorney is handling an application eligible for filing.
action_or_input: Attorney records filing submission to the Indian Patent Office with required filing details.
expected_result: PMS records the Indian Patent Office filing submission.

source_id: PMS-AFR-102: record submission to international patent offices
purpose: Verify an Attorney can record submission of an application to an international patent office.
preconditions: An Attorney is handling an application eligible for international filing and provides required justification.
action_or_input: Attorney records filing submission to an international patent office with justification and filing details.
expected_result: PMS records the international patent office filing submission.

source_id: PMS-AFR-103: require additional justification for international filings
purpose: Verify PMS rejects or blocks recording an international filing when additional justification is missing.
preconditions: An Attorney attempts to record an international patent-office filing without providing additional justification.
action_or_input: Submit international filing details with missing justification.
expected_result: PMS requires additional justification and rejects the incomplete international filing record.

source_id: PMS-AFR-104: capture external filing ID, filing date, and confirmation
purpose: Verify PMS captures external filing ID, filing date, and confirmation for a recorded filing.
preconditions: An Attorney records a patent-office filing.
action_or_input: Provide external filing ID, filing date, and confirmation information and save.
expected_result: PMS stores the external filing ID, filing date, and confirmation on the filing record.

source_id: PMS-AFR-105: update application status to Filed after recording filing
purpose: Verify PMS updates application status to Filed after filing is recorded.
preconditions: A valid patent-office filing is recorded for an eligible application.
action_or_input: Save the recorded filing.
expected_result: PMS updates the application status to Filed.

source_id: PMS-AFR-106: log official communications with patent offices
purpose: Verify PMS logs official communications with patent offices.
preconditions: An official communication with a patent office is recorded in PMS.
action_or_input: Record the official patent-office communication.
expected_result: PMS stores the official communication in the application/office communication log.

source_id: PMS-AFR-107: activate post-grant tracking only for status Granted
purpose: Verify post-grant tracking is active for Granted patents and not activated for non-Granted applications.
preconditions: One application has status Granted and another has a non-Granted status.
action_or_input: Inspect or trigger post-grant tracking on both records.
expected_result: Post-grant tracking operates for the Granted patent and is not active for the non-Granted application.

source_id: PMS-AFR-108: calculate maintenance-fee schedule from grant date and jurisdiction
purpose: Verify PMS calculates maintenance-fee schedules based on grant date and jurisdiction when schedule rules are available.
preconditions: A Granted patent has a grant date and jurisdiction with available maintenance schedule rules.
action_or_input: Generate or view the maintenance-fee schedule for the Granted patent.
expected_result: PMS calculates the maintenance-fee schedule using the grant date and jurisdiction rules.

source_id: PMS-AFR-109: Attorney manages maintenance-fee reminders and deadline tracking
purpose: Verify an Attorney can manage maintenance-fee reminders and deadline tracking.
preconditions: A Granted patent has maintenance-fee tracking in PMS.
action_or_input: Attorney configures or updates maintenance-fee reminders and deadline tracking.
expected_result: PMS saves the Attorney's maintenance-fee reminder and deadline-tracking settings.

source_id: PMS-AFR-110: require explicit renewal decision before maintenance deadline
purpose: Verify PMS requires an explicit renewal decision before each maintenance deadline.
preconditions: A Granted patent approaches a maintenance deadline without a recorded renewal decision.
